 9. Determine nutrition criteria for monitoring and evaluation 
for each nutrition diagnosis you identiﬁ ed.
Progress will be evaluated in a follow-up appointment by 
way of a 24-hour dietary recall, and the calcium intake of 
patient will be compared to the recommended intake of 
1500 mg/day. In addition, the patient’s food journal may be
evaluated for adequate intake of sodium, protein, fruits, and
vegetables. Vitamin D serum levels should be monitored.
10. What other medications might her physician consider to
prevent osteoporosis in this patient?

gen (hormone replacement therapy), and selective estrogen
